name: io.github.jyswee/buggazi
description: Project management for coding agents. Bugs, features, sprints. 71 tools, stdio or remote SSE.

environmentVariables.name: BGZ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Buggazi API key (bgz_...). Optional: without a key the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your Buggazi API key: 'Bearer bgz_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup via the buggazi_signup tool.
